sentences.text: The bank policy’s option to offer a switch to a fixed rate at reset matches the RBI UCB rule that a UCB may, at its option, provide borrowers a choice to switch over to a fixed rate as per its Board-approved policy.
The RBI rule also requires applicable switching and incidental charges, if any, to be transparently disclosed and Board-approved, with website display.
On the evidence provided, there is no conflict shown between the policy wording and the current UCB rule on fixed-rate switch at reset.
